info.title: BookiT / ZakažiSam API
info.description: Appointment booking API. Base path `/api`. All responses are wrapped in `{ success, data }` on 2xx and `{ success:false, message }` on errors.

post.summary: Register a device or browser push subscription for the current user

delete.summary: Remove a push subscription for the current user

get.summary: List recurring slot patterns owned by the current company

schema.description: Pattern JSON schema (weekly rules etc.); validated with Zod

bookedSlotAction.description: How to treat already-booked slots impacted by the edit

409.description: Conflict — booked slots impacted; retry with `bookedSlotAction`
Conflict — booked slots impacted; retry with `bookedSlotAction`

post.summary: Materialize slots from a pattern up through a horizon date
Preview slots that would be generated by a pattern (no writes)

get.summary: Server-Sent Events stream for a company's real-time updates
get.description:
Long-lived `text/event-stream` connection. Emits JSON events for
booking / slot / pattern changes scoped to the authenticated company.
Consumers should use `EventSource` and treat this as append-only.
